title: Moroccan Chickpea Couscous Lunch Jars
hook: 20 minutes tonight and lunch is handled for the week: Moroccan chickpea couscous jars, 4 jars, no reheating
benefit: Plant protein and fiber from the chickpeas and whole wheat couscous, plus vitamin A from the carrots
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
Dressing: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a small pot. Stir in the couscous, cover, take it off the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and spread it on a plate to cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cayenne, honey and salt in a small bowl until smooth.
Toast the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until golden. Tip them onto a plate so they stop cooking.
In a large bowl, toss the chickpeas, carrots, bell pepper, apricots, parsley and mint with the dressing. Fold in the cooled couscous.
Divide among 4 jars or containers and top with the almonds. Lid on; they keep 4 days in the fridge and taste great cold or at room temperature.
vo_steps: Boil the broth, stir in the couscous, cover for five minutes, then fluff and cool.
